data.long_description:
1 Bedroom | Fully Furnished | High Floor | Canal & SZR View

Experience modern living in this elegant 1-bedroom apartment located in Noora Tower, part of the prestigious Al Habtoor City community. Situated on a high floor, this fully furnished unit is in excellent condition and offers beautiful views of the Dubai Water Canal and Sheikh Zayed Road.

The apartment features a bright living and dining area, a well-sized bedroom, and a modern kitchen. It includes one main bathroom and a separate guest toilet, providing added convenience for residents and visitors. Large windows bring in plenty of natural light while showcasing the stunning canal and city views.
